confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of New Zealand pricing, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by location, booking lead time and season. The window is July 2026, which is NZ winter and typically a lower-demand period for accommodation. Drink and meal values assume a conversion of roughly NZD 1 = USD 0.58 to 0.62, so they will move with the exchange rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general New Zealand urban price levels, benchmarked against Auckland and Christchurch. Wellington is typically a little above Christchurch for restaurants and cafés and broadly similar to Auckland for dining, with accommodation priced at ordinary registered hostels and mid-market hotels. No single comparable city was used.
